description: Ari owns a small utility trailer and must decide whether to accept a neighbor's barter proposal for it, settling the vehicle received, cash adjustment, repair work, comparison with another offer, and paperwork at the handoff.

shared_context.S1: Ari has a roadworthy 5-by-8-foot utility trailer that she no longer uses.
shared_context.S2: Ari makes the final decision about what arrangement, if any, to accept for the trailer.
shared_context.S3: Bo has discussed a possible barter, and Clara has discussed possibly buying the trailer for cash.
shared_context.S4: Before a handoff, Ari follows her usual practice of asking everyone present to state any offer, mechanical detail, or paperwork detail relevant to the arrangement.

PF1.text: Bo's specific proposal is to trade Ari his 2012 Honda CBR250R motorcycle plus $60 for the trailer, with the exchange on Sunday at 2:00 p.m.

PF2.text: Clara will pay exactly $450 in cash for the trailer and can collect it on Friday at 6:00 p.m.

PF3.text: After inspecting Bo's motorcycle, Dev found that its front brake hose is cracked and its rear brake pads are worn; the motorcycle should not be accepted without replacing the front hose, replacing the rear pads, and bleeding the brake system.

PF4.text: A5 confirmed with the local clerk that this trailer transfer should use a signed bill of sale and both parties should bring photo identification to the handoff.

acceptance_conditions: Ari must accept Bo's barter rather than Clara's cash purchase.
The barter must specify Bo's 2012 Honda CBR250R and exactly $60 added to Ari's side.
The settlement must record Clara's exact $450 cash alternative.
The motorcycle condition must be addressed by replacing the front brake hose, replacing the rear brake pads, and bleeding the brake system before the exchange.
The handoff must occur Sunday at 2:00 p.m.
A signed bill of sale and photo identification from both parties must be required at the handoff.
Ari must cite the motorcycle inspection when explaining the repair condition.

content_checks.C1: decisions['arrangement'] == 'barter' and decisions['swap_partner'] == 'Bo' and decisions['vehicle_received'] == '2012 Honda CBR250R'
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'brake_repair' and c['target'] == 'Bo' and c['detail'] == 'Replace front brake hose; replace rear brake pads; bleed brake system before exchange' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['paperwork_completed'] == True and any(c['type'] == 'transfer_paperwork' and c['detail'] == 'Signed bill of sale and photo identification from both parties at handoff' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Bo's stated proposal fixes the chosen partner as Bo, the received vehicle as a 2012 Honda CBR250R, the cash adjustment at exactly $60, and the handoff at Sunday at 2:00 p.m.
Clara's offer changes the comparison record from an unknown alternative to an exact $450 cash option.
Dev's inspection changes the motorcycle requirement to replacing the front brake hose, replacing the rear brake pads, and bleeding the brake system before exchange.
The clerk's paperwork guidance changes the handoff from an informal exchange into one requiring a signed bill of sale and photo identification from both parties.
